messages:
Jess: FYI sampleapp started throwing a bunch of 429s around 18:02. Looks like a retry/hedging pattern causing a burst.
Carlos: repro? which SDK and which config?
Jess: repro in go-sdk + our JS sample. Quick repro: enable hedging + aggressive paginator prefetch. When a page request hits a 429 the client hedges immediately, and the prefetch multiplier creates a thundering herd.
Mei: saw a similar blip in staging yesterday under load with adaptive windowing ON.
Ben: yep — hedging + prefetching multiplies in-flight requests. The current SDK counters only count original attempts, not hedged attempts.
Alex: do we have a minimal config that reproduces? can you paste it?
Jess: snippet below (from sampleapp config):
```yaml
client:
  hedging: true
  hedging_delay_ms: 50
  max_hedges: 2
paginator:
  prefetch_pages: 3
  concurrency: 10
```
Carlos: that prefetch_pages x hedges is the killer — 3 pages * up to 2 hedges = ~6 simultaneous attempts per cursor advance.
Ben: short-term mitigation: disable hedging in the sampleapp and drop prefetch_pages to 1 or reduce paginator.concurrency.
Alex: longer term we should: gate hedged attempts against the same in-flight semaphore, and expose an option that treats hedged attempts as "ticket consumers" so they don't exceed client-side quotas. Also add jitter to hedging backoffs.
Infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026 - sdk hedging + pagination causing request surge (assigned: eng-devex)
Jess: I'll submit a small PR to toggle hedging=false by default in the sampleapp and update the quickstart docs to warn about prefetch.
Jess: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/512 toggles hedging off and reduces prefetch to 1
Mei: can we add an e2e that fault-injects 429s and asserts we don't exceed N in-flight?
Ben: yes — add a fault-injection harness that asserts in-flight <= configured concurrency and fails the build if it regresses.
Carlos: tagging this as a DX-bug and moving to sprint-23. Also add an entry in the devex troubleshooting doc.
Alex: good plan. Also consider a telemetry metric for "hedged_attempts" vs "original_attempts" so we can monitor multiplier effect in prod.
Jess: noted — I'll add the metric in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Mei: thanks, great catch.
Ben: learned something new today :brain:
